sources.title: README.md · MidFord327/Hubert-Base-ONNX at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the ONNX-exported version of the Hubert Base model, fine-tuned for voice conversion and compatible with modern inference pipelines. This model allows fast and efficient audio processing in ONNX runtime environments.

sources.title: GitHub - onnx/models: A collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art ...
sources.snippet: Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. This repository is a curated collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art models in the ONNX format.

sources.snippet: ONNX Tutorials Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format for representing machine learning models. ONNX is supported by a community of partners who have implemented it in many frameworks and tools.
